name: GCMM
author: suloku
description_short: Disc Backup Tool for GC/Wii Discs
description_long: A tool to backup your Gamecube/Wii Discs via IOS58 Create 1:1 backups of your GC/Wii discs for archival purposes without any requirements for custom IOS (cIOS). Supports USB 2.0 / NTFS / exFAT & Front SD.
